Class playController

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.controller.playController
public class playController extends Object
Controller for the Play Mode screen. Handles gameplay logic including: - Displaying questions and answers - Managing the countdown timer - Tracking player money - Updating prize tiers - Handling answer selection - Restarting the game - Navigating back to the main menu
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the Play screen. Sets localization, initializes prize tiers, loads the first question, and highlights the starting tier.

    • startTimer

      private void startTimer()
      Starts or restarts the 60-second countdown timer. Disables answer buttons when time runs out.

    • setAnswerButtonsVisible

      private void setAnswerButtonsVisible(boolean visible)
      Shows or hides all answer buttons at once.
      Parameters:
      visible - true to display the buttons, false to hide them

    • onAnswerClick

      private void onAnswerClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles answer button clicks. Determines correctness, updates money and tier, and controls UI visibility.
      Parameters:
      event - the button click event

    • useSuperposition

      private void useSuperposition()
      Removes two incorrect answers at random. Disables the eliminated buttons and locks the lifeline.

    • useEntanglement

      private void useEntanglement()
      Highlights the correct answer and guarantees the player will be marked correct on their next selection.

    • useInterference

      private void useInterference()
      Highlights a suggested answer. If Entanglement was used, Interference will reinforce the same correct answer.
